name: 02631 · Brewster, MA
findings: ZIP 02631 (Brewster) has 52 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (21%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02631 (Brewster) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 02631 (Brewster) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
